退房后怎么走，丢了东西该联系谁。: Plan your day after checkout and know whom to contact if something goes missing.
吃得合适，账单看得懂: Find suitable meals and understand the bill
订位、饮食需求、食物过敏与费用核对。: Handle reservations, dietary needs, food allergies and charges.

给孩子、推车和想少走路的同行人留余量。: Leave room in the plan for children, strollers and companions who prefer less walking.

先打通联系与付款，再核对费用和自动续费。: Set up communication and payments, then review charges and automatic renewals.

检查本地警报、停电入口和家人联络方案。: Check local alerts, outage information and your family's communication plan.
